item.title: Information Processing and Intelligent Systems in 6G Networks
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks contributions on information processing and intelligent systems applications within 6G networks. The call invites research that explores the intersection of advanced computational methods and next-generation wireless communication systems.

Appel publié par Information Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
